L01.rule: Synchronous isolated item event frames; attach/detach passive contributions before PICKUP/DROP; detach slot before DROP, keep valid item fields during DROP, invalidate after RemoveItem DROP returns; explicit RemoveItem idempotent; no generic script-stat rollback. SPELL frame manipulatedItem=null, restoring outer frame after nested calls.
L01.missingAbilityList: Source null retained; local Web mounts no implicit ability for absent abilList; explicit script effects still execute. Raw repeated entries retained with separate contribution origin, resolved stacking delegated to the ability module.

L02.rule: D01/D02 retained. First-empty-slot before synchronous pickup; full script add returns false and preserves creation coordinates. Powerup explicit1 uses ephemeral pickup context without slot, then resolved pickup effect and removes still-existing token; no ordinary DROP because never slotted. Slot-only reorder causes no pickup/drop. Sorted numeric pairs traversal, exact recipe order preserved.

L03.rule: Accepted non-AIbl use snapshots source ability/caster/target, debits one positive charge then USE_ITEM then SPELL_EFFECT; zero perishable removal deferred until both entire synchronous chains return and only if original instance still exists and remains zero. AIbl separately governed S02, never double-debit. Command failure before commit no debit/events. Effects may explicitly remove whole items or restore charges; no generic refund.

L04.rule: Explicit usable=1 required. Explicit uses>0 identifies finite use gate charges>=1; absent uses remains null in source, Web init charge-counter0 and unlimited-use mode only for explicit usable1 (unless specific module overrides). Positive runtime charges still debit once; zero persistent counter permitted. Perishable deletion only explicit1 after accepted use, not every SetItemCharges(0). Explicit droppable1/pawnable1 required unless script setter changes instance flag; script removals bypass UI flags.

missingLevelFallback.reason: Only six in the425 custom rows lack Level; all explicitly powerup1. No w3t level override; local Web level0 lets original pickup gates reach their explicit reward dispatch. No blanket Level0 for other unknown objects.

L04.chargeWrite: SetItemCharges updates counter only; no pickup/drop, no automatic growth-stat recomputation or deletion. Growth kill/write helpers must retain their own explicit resource writes.

L05.rule: Pawn requires resolved nonnegative gold quote, explicit/instance pawn permission, valid owned carried instance and reachable visible allowed shop. Gold=floor(quote*multiplier/2), multiplier=charges/initialUses for explicit initialUses>0, otherwise1; entire item removed, growth counters do not raise permanent-item quote. This local Web pawn operation returns gold only, no lumber/points; missing gold quote means unavailable, never zero quote. Credit once, detach/DROP/remove once, no SELL_ITEM handler or shop restock. Runtime transaction already committed is not refunded by DROP callbacks.

L06.rule: Auto-use requests all independent branches in source order. Zero timers enter B05 tail; callbacks recheck item still alive and carried by saved caster and normal per-ability command prerequisites, target/unit validity. Failed request returns false, no charge/cooldown/event; timer still destroyed with all saved entries cleared, no retry. Point snapshot does not follow later target movement.

L07.rule: Save only after current synchronous transaction/event stack and cleanup completes; then persist actual item state/mounted contributions, ordered pending timers and stable handles, RNG, sparse script tables, charges, locks/ignore markers, resources, per-shop counts. Restore data without replaying pickup/drop/use/sale or script stat changes. Independent timer B05 boundaries remain saveable.

L08.rule: For ordinary physical purchase D02 commits price/stock and attaches item then PICKUP, then SELL_ITEM carrying original instance handle even if pickup removed it. Such deleted item getters return0; no inferred refund/replacement. Explicit virtual-menu transactions dispatch their existing script rules without an invented inventory slot or object-price charge; powerup flows use L02. The personal Fshop selector is repaired separately by explicit user decision Q44.

L09.rule: Local invalid item handle getters return0 for scalar/type/charge and null for handle; setters/removal no-op; current DROP removing handle stays readable until callback returns, but recursive RemoveItem on already-removing handle no-ops. No blanket native-handle rule outside this module.

Q44.rule: In personal mode select the stock table by GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetBuyingUnit()))+1. Decrement the matching sold item once; at remaining<=0 remove it from the actual selling shop. No reliance on _ENV.unit.
Q44.sourceFact: GAME_ENDLESS_TYPE==1 reads _ENV.unit before GetBuyingUnit, picks upvalue9 table using owner(unit)+1. Only two literal unit constants in full disassembly, both global reads; no static assignment in Lua/JASS found. Host dynamic injection unknown. Personal mode is reachable.
